title: 30A Vistas Sandpiper Vacation Rentals
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - ACCESS TO THE PUBLIC WIDE BEACH (OR PRIVATE FOR MAIN TOWNS) WITH NO RESTRICTIONS. - Gorgeous condo overlooking the Seacrest town square - 2 adult sized beach cruiser bikes - 2 KING rooms - Community grill - Fully stocked kitchen - Seacrest Private beach access with seasonal tram service - Smart TV's in each bedroom and living room - Sandpiper Linen Program Participant: All linen, bedding and bath, are the highest quality. OPTIONAL ADD-ON: -Vacation Cancellation Protection- Allows cancellation for any reason up to 48 hours in advance of stay and guarantees 50% of all monies refunded ($125 fee applies at booking) Located in The Village of South Walton in Seacrest Beach, 30A Vistas is your perfect upscale beach retreat. This 3-bedroom condo sleeps 7 and is located on the 3rd floor, providing a bird’s eye view of 30A and even a little peek at the Gulf! It's decorated in a contemporary and comfortable style sure to make you feel like it's your home-away-from home. The sophisticated, open-concept feel to this condo makes for a welcoming and relaxing spot after a day on the beach. The kitchen is well equipped for all your meal and snack prep needs. There's seating for 4 at the bar and 4 more at the dining table, plus there is seating on the balcony for 4. 2 bedrooms have king beds and the 3rd room has a bunk bed that is perfect for the kids. The 2 bathrooms in the home have amazing updates, both with cool gray tones and warm brass accents. The generously sized shower in the master bath gives you a true spa experience! Accommodations (Sleeps 7): Bedroom 1: King bed, TV. Private access to shared hallway bath with tub/shower combo and dual sinks. Bedroom 2: Twin-over-full bed, TV. Bedroom 3: King bed, TV, sitting area, balcony access. Private bathroom with dual sinks and extra large shower. VILLAGE OF SOUTH WALTON The Village has direct access to Sunset Beach and it's only a short walk away. Or, for your convenience, the seasonal tram will transport you to and from the beach. There are 2 large private pools at the Village with plenty of loungers and patio seating. Plus, there is a community grill area for your BBQ cravings. There is on-site coin laundry available for your convenience. There are several dining options at the Village as well as shops and bike rentals all right at your fingertips. Right next door to the Village you can easily walk or bike to Rosemary Beach via the trail that parallels 30A. Rosemary Beach is a little piece of European flair in Florida. Have your pick of first-class dining options, one-of-a-kind boutiques, and picnic friendly green spaces. Hop in the car to head to Pier Park in Panama City Beach to the east, or make your way west to famous Seaside. Village of South Walton is the perfect location for your beach getaway to create memories that will last a lifetime. * Sorry, no pets allowed. * Parking for 2 cars on first come first served basis * No golf cart parking allowed in this community * Seacrest amenities include access to the condo pool and private beach. Shops and restaurants are right outside your door! * Must be 25 yrs or older to rent.
